known_differences.description: fsci-stats implements 105+ continuous/discrete distributions, hypothesis tests, correlations, CensoredData, Covariance, and QMC.

threats.description: Catastrophic cancellation in KL divergence / relative entropy when probability distributions p and q are nearly equal.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-stats/src/lib.rs:38958 (pearsonr): uses numerically stable centered inner products and delegates kl_divergence elementwise terms to fsci_special::rel_entr (log1p).
threats.strict_mode_response: Compute accurate relative entropy and correlation within <= 2 ULPs of reference.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Reject non-finite or negative probability weights fail-closed.

threats.description: Empty sample arrays, non-finite observations, mismatched paired sample lengths, or non-PSD covariance matrices passed to statistical routines.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-stats/src/lib.rs:358 (validate_or_project_sample): validates sample size and finiteness, or projects non-finite observations under Hardened + RecoveryPolicy::Project with an audited BoundedRecovery event.
threats.strict_mode_response: Return NaN or StatsError matching SciPy stats conventions.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Reject malformed or non-finite samples with AuditAction::FailClosed by default, or project non-finite observations under RecoveryPolicy::Project with AuditAction::BoundedRecovery.

threats.description: Exact permutation/rank distribution recurrences in Mann-Whitney U or KS tests blowing up on large sample sizes.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-stats/src/lib.rs:37420 (mannwhitneyu): switches from exact dynamic programming to normal/tie-corrected asymptotic approximation above threshold or when ties are present.
threats.strict_mode_response: Select exact vs asymptotic method matching SciPy auto rule.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Bound exact table allocation size and emit audit record on error.

threats.description: Two-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov p-value calculation drifting between Smirnov exact and Kolmogorov asymptotic distributions.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-stats/src/lib.rs:48221 (kstest): dispatches one-sample and two-sample KS statistics with exact/asymp p-value evaluation matching SciPy.
threats.strict_mode_response: Match SciPy kstest statistic and p-value across alternatives.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Validate finite sample observations before empirical CDF sort.

fail_closed_policies.strict_mode_action: Return StatsError::InsufficientData or NaN per SciPy contract.
fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Return StatsError and record FailClosed in AuditLedger.
Reject non-finite observations fail-closed with FailClosed audit record.
Return StatsError::InvalidParameter and log FailClosed event.

fail_closed_policies.strict_mode_action: Return NaN or Err on domain violation.
